title: Assessment of Generative Named Entity Recognition in the Era of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.17898v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is evolving from a sequence labeling task into a generative paradigm with the rise of large language models (LLMs). We conduct a systematic evaluation of open-source LLMs on both flat and nested NER tasks. We investigate several research questions including the performance gap between generative NER and traditional NER models, the impact of output formats, whether LLMs rely on memorization, and the preservation of general capabilities after fine-tuning. Through experiments across eight LLMs of varying scales and four standard NER datasets, we find that: (1) With parameter-efficient fine-tuning and structured formats like inline bracketed or XML, open-source LLMs achieve performance competitive with traditional encoder-based models and surpass decoder-based LLMs with in-context learning techniques; (2) The NER capability of LLMs stems from instruction-following and generative power, not mere memorization

translated_title: 大语言模型时代生成式命名实体识别的评估
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的兴起，命名实体识别（NER）正从序列标注任务演变为一种生成式范式。我们对开源大语言模型在扁平NER和嵌套NER任务上进行了系统性评估。我们研究了多个研究问题，包括生成式NER与传统NER模型之间的性能差距、输出格式的影响、大语言模型是否依赖记忆，以及微调后通用能力的保持情况。通过在八个不同规模的大语言模型和四个标准NER数据集上的实验，我们发现：(1) 通过参数高效微调和结构化格式（如内联括号或XML），开源大语言模型取得了与传统基于编码器的模型相当的性能，并超越了采用上下文学习技术的基于解码器的大语言模型；(2) 大语言模型的NER能力源于指令遵循能力和生成能力，而非单纯的记忆。
tldr: 通过对八个大语言模型在四个标准NER数据集上的系统评估发现，采用参数高效微调和结构化输出格式的开源大语言模型可实现与传统基于编码器的模型相媲美的命名实体识别性能，且其能力来源于指令遵循与生成能力而非记忆。
en_tdlr: A systematic evaluation of eight LLMs across four NER datasets shows that open-source LLMs with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and structured output formats achieve performance competitive with traditional encoder-based NER models, and their capability stems from instruction-following and generative power rather than memorization.
